mapper.sql: tp.ticket_product_id AS product_id, tp.place_id, tp.name AS product_name, tp.description, p.name AS place_name, p.region, p.city, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image_url, tpo.ticket_product_option_id AS option_id, tpo.name AS option_name, tts.ticket_time_slot_id AS slot_id, tts.usage_date, tts.start_time, tts.end_time, tpo.unit_price, tpo.currency_code AS currency, tpo.max_quantity_per_user, (ti.total_quantity - ti.reserved_quantity) AS remaining_quantity,

tp.sale_type, tp.sale_start_at, tp.sale_end_at, CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < tp.sale_start_at THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > tp.sale_end_at THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'ON_SALE' END AS sale_state, CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < tp.sale_start_at THEN tp.sale_start_at END AS opens_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tp.status = 'ON_SALE' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN tp.sale_start_at AND tp.sale_end_at AND tts.status = 'OPEN' AND tts.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND ti.reserved_quantity < ti.total_quantity AND (#{destination} IS NULL OR #{destination} = '' OR CONCAT_WS(' ', p.region, p.city, p.address, p.name) ILIKE '%' || #{destination} || '%') ORDER BY tts.usage_date, tts.start_time NULLS FIRST, tp.ticket_product_id, tpo.sort_order
mapper.sql:
FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tp.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP <= tp.sale_end_at AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= tp.sale_start_at OR tp.sale_type = 'SCHEDULED') AND tts.status = 'OPEN' AND ti.reserved_quantity < ti.total_quantity AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR CONCAT_WS(' ', tp.name, p.region, p.city, p.address, p.name) ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT tp.ticket_product_id AS product_id, tp.name AS product_name, tp.description, tp.place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.region, p.city, , (SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image_url, MIN(tpo.unit_price) AS min_unit_price, MIN(tpo.currency_code) AS currency, MIN(tts.usage_date) AS first_usage_date, MAX(tts.usage_date) AS last_usage_date, COUNT(*) AS available_slot_count, SUM(ti.total_quantity - ti.reserved_quantity) AS remaining_quantity
GROUP BY tp.ticket_product_id, tp.name, tp.description, tp.place_id, p.name, p.region, p.city, p.place_id, tp.sale_start_at, tp.sale_end_at, tp.sale_type ORDER BY MIN(tts.usage_date), tp.ticket_product_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT tp.ticket_product_id AS product_id, tp.name AS product_name, tp.description, tp.place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.region, p.city, , (SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image_url, MIN(tpo.unit_price) AS min_unit_price, MIN(tpo.currency_code) AS currency, MIN(tts.usage_date) AS first_usage_date, MAX(tts.usage_date) AS last_usage_date, COUNT(*) AS available_slot_count, SUM(ti.total_quantity - ti.reserved_quantity) AS remaining_quantity FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tp.ticket_product_id = #{productId} AND tp.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP <= tp.sale_end_at AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= tp.sale_start_at OR tp.sale_type = 'SCHEDULED') AND tts.status = 'OPEN' AND ti.reserved_quantity < ti.total_quantity GROUP BY tp.ticket_product_id, tp.name, tp.description, tp.place_id, p.name, p.region, p.city, p.place_id, tp.sale_start_at, tp.sale_end_at, tp.sale_type

SELECT FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tp.ticket_product_id = #{productId} AND tp.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP <= tp.sale_end_at AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= tp.sale_start_at OR tp.sale_type = 'SCHEDULED') AND tts.status = 'OPEN' AND ti.reserved_quantity < ti.total_quantity ORDER BY tts.usage_date, tts.start_time NULLS FIRST, tpo.sort_order

SELECT FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tts.ticket_time_slot_id = #{slotId} AND tp.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND tts.status = 'OPEN' FOR UPDATE OF ti

SELECT FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_product_options tpo ON tpo.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND tpo.is_active = TRUE JOIN ticket_time_slots tts ON tts.ticket_product_option_id = tpo.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = tts.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE tts.ticket_time_slot_id = #{slotId} AND tp.status = 'ON_SALE' AND tts.status = 'OPEN'
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_number, trip_id, user_id, status, total_amount, currency_code, request_key, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationNumber}, #{tripId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', #{totalAmount}, #{currency}, #{requestKey}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' )
mapper.sql: r.reservation_id, r.reservation_number, r.trip_id, r.user_id, r.status, r.total_amount, r.currency_code AS currency, r.request_key, r.expires_at, ri.ticket_time_slot_id AS slot_id, ri.product_name, ri.option_name, ri.usage_date, ri.usage_start_time, ri.quantity, ri.unit_price
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.request_key = #{requestKey} ORDER BY ri.reservation_item_id LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = ri.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ri.reservation_item_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF r, ti

SELECT , ts.end_time AS usage_end_time, pl.name AS place_name, pay.method AS payment_method, pay.provider AS payment_provider, pay.approved_at AS paid_at FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id LEFT JOIN ticket_time_slots ts ON ts.ticket_time_slot_id = ri.ticket_time_slot_id LEFT JOIN ticket_product_options po ON po.ticket_product_option_id = ts.ticket_product_option_id LEFT JOIN ticket_products tp ON tp.ticket_product_id = po.ticket_product_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.place_id = tp.place_id LEFT JOIN payments pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND pay.status = 'PAID' WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id JOIN ticket_inventory ti ON ti.ticket_time_slot_id = ri.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY r.expires_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF r, ti SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT t.status FROM issued_tickets t JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_item_id = t.reservation_item_id WHERE ri.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY t.issued_ticket_id FOR UPDATE OF t
mapper.update: UPDATE issued_tickets t SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM reservation_items ri WHERE ri.reservation_item_id = t.reservation_item_id AND ri.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND t.status = 'ISSUED'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'REFUNDED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'PAID'
UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
